# TSLA — Technicals

## TL;DR

TSLA is in a trend-transition zone as of May 1, 2026. The confirmed April downtrend (ADX 29.5, bearish EMAs) has partially unwound post-earnings: daily 10/21 EMAs are now marginally above each other but still below the 50 and 200 EMAs. Price surged ~3.8% intraday on 2.74x volume, firing the hourly squeeze — but landed squarely in the well-documented $387–$399 bear-rally resistance cluster. R/R fails 2:1 at every proposed entry. Setup type: **watch, not act.** [source: run 20260501_160246 signals_combined.json]

## Key levels

| Level | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Documented resistance cluster | $399–$409 | 14–15 test zone; prior short zone Apr 15 |
| Bear-rally resistance | $387–$399 | Fib/EMA confluence; current price mid-zone |
| 38.2% Fib support | $381.76 | Apr 30 daily close at $381.63 — strong confluence |
| 50% Fib | $373.26 | Apr 30 intraday low probed $368; recovery bullish |
| Entry watch zone | $381–$385 | Pullback target with bullish daily candle for 2:1 R/R |
| Stop for watch-zone entry | $365 | Below 61.8% Fib; $365 stop / $409 target = 2.7:1 |
| 50 EMA (daily) | $385.82 | Price must reclaim and hold above for trend confirmation |
| 200 EMA (daily) | $389.24 | Second resistance ceiling above 50 EMA |

## Setup type

**Post-breakout wait** — the hourly squeeze fired and price surged into $387–$399 resistance zone (identical to the April 15 short entry zone). Head Trader (48 conf) says "watch, not act." The prior setup type (bear-rally short) has been retired by the post-earnings recovery. No short is valid while price is recovering from the Apr 30 Fib bounce; no long is valid while R/R at current prices fails 2:1.

**Ideal entry condition:** Pullback to $381–$385 with a bullish daily candle, stop $365, target $409 — that yields 2.7:1. Until that prints, this is a monitor-only setup.

**Prior setup archived to recent.md:** Confirmed daily downtrend with ADX 29.5, bear-rally short at $391.86 (Apr 15, 1 share, unexecuted). [source: runs/20260415_093758, bootstrap]

## Last updated

2026-05-01. Prices as of run 20260501_160246 (daily close $381.63, hourly current $396.09). Stale within 7 days.
